api.notes: Width divided by height. The attribute takes a decimal or a fraction (`ratio="16/9"`); the property also takes a number (`16 / 9`). Required upstream; missing or invalid falls back to a square with a dev warning.

api.reason: A-xstyle: use `::part(base)` (also for `aspect-ratio` inside media or container queries), the host, or the attributes or the documented attributes.
The element itself is the handle; the box is reachable as part "base".

differences.text: `ratio` also accepts a fraction string (`16/9`) because an attribute is text; upstream types it as a number and calls the string form an error.

The fit sizing (cover, contain) ships as ::slotted() rules on the direct child instead of upstream's reset.css rules keyed on data-astryx-aspect-ratio-override; like those, they lose to any style on the child itself.

The ratio is set through the private --_ratio custom property read by a class-level declaration on part="base", so a consumer rule on ::part(base) (also inside @media or @container) overrides it, matching upstream's CSS-variable indirection for xstyle.

core.aspect-ratio.notes: Guides: [mwg:css-layout] `aspect-ratio`, `overflow: clip`, reserving space; [mwg:styling-web-components] `::slotted()` loses to light-DOM rules, part=base; [mwg:shadow-dom] slot inside an absolutely positioned wrapper.
